Name: Lighter and Brighter Gravel Paths
Author: MiniJessia
Description:
I always wanted my [b]gravel paths[/b] to be lighter and brighter and fit the vanilla or close to vanilla color themes so I made this version by modifying the colors a bit.

[b]In the screenshots the only recolor I'm using is the amazing [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30675][b]Changing Seasons recolor at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/b]

[/url]This is my first ever mod, so please let me know if there's anything that needs to be fixed!

Downloads.Description: Small manifest changes. Use this with Alternative Texture mod. It's a texture for the vanilla Gravel Path.
